content:
The image shows a mango leaf with irregular brown to dark brown spots on the upper leaf surface. The lesions are irregular/oval-shaped, dark brown, somewhat sunken in appearance, and distributed across the leaf blade. There is no white powdery coating (rules out Powdery Mildew), no black sooty encrustation (rules out Sooty Mould), and no gum secretion or twig withering (rules out Die Back). The spots match Anthracnose: irregular brown lesions on the leaf surface, consistent with the description of "oval or irregular brown to deep brown sunken spots on leaves."
